_comment: Example MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) configuration. MPP is configured at two levels: (1) server-side mpp_policy on channels to require payment, and (2) client-side mpp_proxy pipes to automatically pay upstream servers.

server_side_channel_example._comment: Add 'mpp_policy' to a channel definition in your gateway config to require MPP payments for incoming requests.

client_side_pipe_example._comment: Add an mpp_proxy pipe to automatically pay upstream MPP-enabled services. Uses the same wallet/network config as x402_proxy (x402-proxy.json).

stripe_payment_methods_example._comment: Add 'stripe_payment_methods' to your x402-proxy.json config alongside wallets/networks. These are used by mpp_proxy pipes to fulfil card/stripe challenges.
